cc:Work.dc:title: Box - SlidingLidBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with rails for a sliding lid
* The sliding lid rests on the lower rails and is kept in place by the upper rails. * When using inner measurements, the height goes from bottom to lid, the lower rail is inside of the inner height. * The width of the rail can be adjusted, wider rails are more stable but make the opening smaller. * The horizontal margin makes the lid slightly narrower to prevent the lid from jamming. * The vertical margin makes the gap between the rails larger to let the lid slide more easily.
![Closed](static/samples/SlidingLidBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SlidingLidBox --FingerJoint_style=rectangular --FingerJoint_surroundingspaces=2.0 --FingerJoint_bottom_lip=0.0 --FingerJoint_edge_width=3 --FingerJoint_extra_length=0.0 --FingerJoint_finger=5 --FingerJoint_play=0.0 --FingerJoint_space=5 --FingerJoint_width=1.0 --x=250 --y=500 --h=250 --outside=0 --top_edge=h --bottom_edge=h --rail=1.5 --margin_t=0.1 --margin_s=0.05 --lid_type=hole --hole_length=40 --hole_width=20 --hole_radius=10 '--vertical_edges=finger holes' --thickness=6 --burn=0.1 --format=svg --labels=0 --labels=1 --reference=100.0 --tabs=0.0 --qr_code=0 --inner_corners=loop --spacing=0.5 --debug=0 Command line short: boxes SlidingLidBox --FingerJoint_edge_width=3 --FingerJoint_finger=5
